title: Alexander Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Positioned prominently between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach lies this incredible 3 bedroom 3 bathroom rental condo in the highly sought after Alexander development.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGTS: - 3 KING Suites and 3 BATHS! Perfect for a multiple couple get-away! - Large TVs in each bedroom and living area - Oversized open-air balconies with comfortable seating - High end furnishings throughout - 2 Beach Cruiser Bikes - PUBLIC BEACH ACCESS - Fully Stocked Kitchen - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. ADDITIONAL ADD-ONS: -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) Positioned prominently between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach lies this incredible 3 bedroom 3 bathroom rental condo in the highly sought after Alexander development. Unit 203 is located on the 2nd floor, highlighted by travertine flooring, wood cabinetry, granite countertops and an oversized balcony offering incredible views over Alys Beach along Scenic 30A. Experience luxury beach living in this stunning condo. With 3 bedrooms, 3 full baths, and a spacious living area, it provides the perfect space for relaxation. The well-appointed kitchen, tray ceilings, and new lighting fixtures add elegance to the interior. Bamboo and tile flooring, along with granite countertops, create a stylish and open atmosphere. Enjoy breathtaking sunsets and sweeping views of Alys Beach from your large private balcony, perfect for entertaining guests. The primary suite features large glass doors, a walk-in closet, and a luxurious en-suite bath. Take a refreshing dip in the resort-style lagoon pool or catch a tram to the beach for some fun in the sand and gulf. Perfectly located between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, this prime location offers easy access to the... the best shopping and dining on 30A. Sleeping Arrangements - sleeps 6 1 King, TV, ensuite bath 1 King, TV, ensuite bath 1 King, TV access to hallway bath *Public beach Access* FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
